
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr><td class="t_f" id="postmessage_55494415">
<strong><br>
前言</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
写理工科论文经常会遇到一个痛点： 从Markdown/LaTeX笔记、在线文档复制公式段落粘贴到Word后，文本里塞满大量冗余标记： 多余空格、公式外层包裹圆括号<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">( Fy )</font></font>、反斜杠<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\pi</font></font>、美元符号<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">$</font></font>、大括号<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">{}</font></font>、Markdown下划线下标<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">F_y</font></font>…… 手动逐个删除、改下标、替换希腊符号极其浪费时间，格式还容易出错。</font></font></font><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
我用AI写了个宏脚本，选中段落一键完成全部标准化清理，适配惯性/压电/力学类论文公式排版，所有操作仅作用于选中区域，不会误改全文，下面完整分享代码+使用教程。</font></font></font><strong><br>
一、宏脚本核心功能一览</strong><strong><br>
1. 批量清除冗余空白</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
遍历选中所有段落，一次性删除<strong>半角空格</strong>、<strong>中文全角空格</strong>，解决<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">( Fy )</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">θ ∈ [-π/2, π/2]</font></font>这类括号、公式内多余空格问题。</font></font></font><strong><br>
2. 清除Markdown/LaTeX多余标记</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
自动删除粘贴残留符号：<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">$</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">{}</font></font>大括号，无需手动查找替换。</font></font></font><strong><br>
3. 剔除公式外层多余包裹括号</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
兼容4种常见带空格/无空格格式：<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">(Fy)</font></font> / <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">( Fy)</font></font> / <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">(Fy )</font></font> / <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">( Fy )</font></font>，一键删除首尾括号，保留内部公式内容。</font></font></font><strong><br>
4. Markdown下划线自动转Word标准下标</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
识别<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">F_y</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">x_1</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">sigma_xy</font></font>格式，删除下划线，仅将下划线后字符设置为Word下标字体，完美匹配期刊论文排版规范。</font></font></font><strong><br>
5. LaTeX希腊符号标准化转换</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
自动识别<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\theta</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\pi</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\sin</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\cos</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\in</font></font>，清除多余反斜杠，替换为Word可直接显示的标准字符：<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">θ</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">π</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">sin</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">cos</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">∈</font></font>。这里只处理了这几个希腊符号，后续使用中涉及到新的符号可以手动添加并验证</font></font></font><strong><br>
6. 安全范围限制</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
所有查找、替换操作仅在<strong>你选中的段落</strong>内执行，不会跳出选区改动文档其他内容，不用担心误删正文。</font></font></font><strong><br>
二、完整可直接复制的VBA宏代码</strong><br>
Sub FixMarkdownFormulaFinal()&nbsp; &nbsp; Dim srcRng As Range&nbsp; &nbsp; Dim tmpRng As Range&nbsp; &nbsp; Dim para As Paragraph&nbsp; &nbsp; Dim rng As Range&nbsp; &nbsp; Set srcRng = Selection.Range&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'===================== 功能1：清除选中段落内全部半角+全角空格 =====================&nbsp; &nbsp; For Each para In Selection.Paragraphs&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Set rng = para.Range&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'1. 删除半角空格 ASCII=32&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rng.Find.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rng.Find.Replacement.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;With rng.Find&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.Text = " "&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.Replacement.Text = ""&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.Forward = True&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.Wrap = wdFindStop '只在本段内查找，不跳出段落&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.Format = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchCase = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchWholeWord = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchByte = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchAllWordForms = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchSoundsLike = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;.MatchWildcards = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;End With&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; '2. 删除中文全角空格 ChrW(12288)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rng.Find.Text = ChrW(12288)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;rng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; Next para&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'===================== 功能2：清除 $ { } Markdown无用标记 =====================&nbsp; &nbsp; Set tmpRng = srcRng.Duplicate&nbsp; &nbsp; With tmpRng.Find&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.MatchWildcards = False&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Wrap = wdFindStop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "$": .Replacement.Text = "": .Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "{": .Replacement.Text = "": .Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "}": .Replacement.Text = "": .Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; End With&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'===================== 功能3：清除公式外层带空格/无空格包裹括号 ( xxx ) =====================&nbsp; &nbsp; Set tmpRng = srcRng.Duplicate&nbsp; &nbsp; With tmpRng.Find&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.MatchWildcards = True&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Wrap = wdFindStop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'匹配四种括号格式：(xxx)、( xxx)、(xxx )、( xxx )&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "\( ([!)]@) \)"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.Text = "\1"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Do While .Execute(Replace:=wdReplaceOne)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Loop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "\( ([!)]@)\)"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.Text = "\1"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Do While .Execute(Replace:=wdReplaceOne)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Loop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "\(([!)]@) \)"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.Text = "\1"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Do While .Execute(Replace:=wdReplaceOne)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Loop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "\(([!)]@)\)"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.Text = "\1"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Do While .Execute(Replace:=wdReplaceOne)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Loop&nbsp; &nbsp; End With&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'===================== 功能4：Markdown下划线 F_y 自动转为Word下标 =====================&nbsp; &nbsp; Set tmpRng = srcRng.Duplicate&nbsp; &nbsp; With tmpRng.Find&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Replacement.ClearFormatting&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.MatchWildcards = True&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Wrap = wdFindStop&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;.Text = "([A-Za-z0-9])_([A-Za-z0-9])"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Do While .Execute(Forward:=True)&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "\1\2"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceOne&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.MoveStart wdCharacter, 1&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Font.Subscript = True&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;tmpRng.Collapse wdCollapseEnd&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;Loop&nbsp; &nbsp; End With&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;'===================== 功能5：LaTeX希腊符号标准化，清除多余反斜杠 =====================&nbsp; &nbsp; Set tmpRng = srcRng.Duplicate&nbsp; &nbsp; '临时保护数学算子，避免被误删反斜杠&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\theta": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "##THETA##": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\pi": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "##PI##": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\sin": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "##SIN##": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\cos": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "##COS##": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\in": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "##IN##": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; '删除文档中剩余所有孤立反斜杠 \&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.MatchWildcards = False&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "\": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; '还原为论文标准字符&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "##THETA##": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "θ": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "##PI##": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "π": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "##SIN##": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "sin": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "##COS##": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "cos": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp; tmpRng.Find.Text = "##IN##": tmpRng.Find.Replacement.Text = "∈": tmpRng.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;MsgBox "Markdown公式清理完成：已清除全部空格、外层括号、$、{}，下标自动转换，希腊符号标准化", vbInformationEnd Sub<strong><br>
三、完整安装&amp;使用步骤（新手）</strong><strong><br>
步骤1：打开Word VBA编辑器</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
打开你的论文Word文档，按下快捷键 <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Alt + F11</font></font>，调出VBA代码编辑器。</font></font></font><strong><br>
步骤2：新建模块粘贴代码</strong><ul type="1" class="litype_1"><li><br>
左侧工程面板右键你的文档名称 → 【插入】→【模块】；</li><li><br>
清空右侧空白代码窗口；</li><li><br>
复制上面全部代码，粘贴到模块窗口内。<br>
</li></ul><strong><br>
步骤3：运行宏处理文本</strong><ul type="1" class="litype_1"><li><br>
返回Word页面，<strong>鼠标选中你需要清理的整段公式文字</strong>；</li><li><br>
再次按 <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Alt + F11</font></font> 回到编辑器，点击顶部工具栏「运行」按钮（&amp;#9654;），或直接按F5；</li><li><br>
弹出提示框即代表处理完成，查看文本格式自动标准化。<br>
</li></ul><strong><br>
进阶：绑定快捷键一键调用（推荐长期使用）</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
每次打开编辑器运行比较麻烦，可以绑定专属快捷键：</font></font></font><ul type="1" class="litype_1"><li><br>
Word顶部【文件】→【选项】→【自定义功能区】；</li><li><br>
窗口右下角点击「自定义（键盘快捷方式）」；</li><li><br>
左侧类别选择【宏】，右侧选中 <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">FixMarkdownFormulaFinal</font></font>；</li><li><br>
在「请按新快捷键」输入框按下组合键（推荐 <font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Ctrl+Shift+F</font></font>，无系统冲突）；</li><li><br>
点击【指定】→【关闭】，后续选中文本直接按快捷键一键执行。<br>
</li></ul><strong><br>
四、处理前后效果对比</strong><ul type="1" class="litype_1"><li><br>
所有多余空格全部消除；</li><li><br>
公式外层<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">( xxx )</font></font>包裹括号全部删除；</li><li><br>
<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">F_y</font></font>下划线清除，<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">y</font></font>自动转为下标；</li><li><br>
<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\sin\theta</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">\pi</font></font>清除反斜杠，替换为标准<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">sinθ</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">π</font></font>；</li><li><br>
无<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">$</font></font>、<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">{}</font></font>等多余标记，完全符合中文核心/SCI期刊排版要求。<br>
</li></ul><br>

添加图片注释，不超过 140 字（可选）<strong><br>
五、常见问题答疑</strong><strong><br>
Q1：运行后括号没有删掉？</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
A：操作前务必完整选中整段文字，宏仅处理选中区域；代码会先清空所有空格再匹配括号，若仍有残留可重新选中再次运行一次。</font></font></font><strong><br>
Q2：<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Fy</font></font>没有变成下标？</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
A：原文本必须保留Markdown原始下划线格式<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">F_y</font></font>；如果复制时下划线丢失变成<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Fy</font></font>，脚本无法识别下标位置。</font></font></font><strong><br>
Q3：宏被Word禁用怎么办？</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
A：文件→选项→信任中心→信任中心设置→宏设置，选择「启用所有宏」；仅用于自己的论文文档，陌生文件不建议开启。</font></font></font><strong><br>
Q4：可以永久保存宏，新建文档也能用吗？</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
A：将代码复制到<font style="background-color:rgb(246, 246, 246)"><font face="Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, &amp;quot">Normal.dotm</font></font>全局模板，放入Word启动文件夹，所有新建文档均可直接调用快捷键。</font></font></font><strong><br>
六、补充说明</strong><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
单行的公式，直接复制到MathType手动微调一下再插入word就行</font></font></font><font style="color:rgb(25, 27, 31)"><font face="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &amp;quot"><font style="font-size:16px"><br>
<br>
